inlines.text: 이 페이지는 인구·노동·고용·배급 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.
소비자 계약(conservation-no-roll): Population identity partition conserved; sum(dt*availability*approvedTaskFactor), availability in [0,1], factor>=0; C factor table unresolved, never use A (a+2)/6.

blocks.text:
population [bounded-symbolic-contract] N=|living cohort IDs|+|living individual IDs|; extract k: A-k,I+k; return r: A+r,I-r
summoned-subset [bounded-symbolic-contract] summoned IDs subset of individual IDs; summoning the already individualized three does not subtract three again
reservation [bounded-symbolic-contract] a.start < b.end AND b.start < a.end
remaining-demand [bounded-symbolic-contract] max(0,need-sum(distinct verified deliveries for same person,needId,unit))
wage-arrears [bounded-symbolic-contract] max(0,contractuallyDue-verifiedPaid)
D04-F1 [후보·승인 전] N=card(livingCohort)+card(livingIndividuals); extract k: cohort-k,individual+k; overlap=a.start<b.end && b.start<a.end
D04-F2 [후보·승인 전] effectiveHours=sum(dt*availability*taskFactor); A-only comparison factor=(a+2)/6; B/C require their own factor policy
D04-F3 [후보·승인 전] unmet=max(0,need-uniqueDelivered); arrears=max(0,due-paid)

inlines.text: D04의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: people — Person[] (existing member tokens linked to permanent PersonId)
start,end — safe integer (same world-clock tick; scale not authored)
need,delivered,wageDue,wagePaid — safe nonnegative integer (explicit identical contract item/currency unit)
eligibility — authored source-bound requirement table (contract predicates)
health — upstream approved state (upstream HP/FP and separate needs state)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D04 design evidence only, 유지 계약은 population·summoned-subset·reservation·remaining-demand·wage-arrears다. 상태 소유 경계는 person token/cohort partition,living IDs,time reservations,actual work intervals,D02 availability,wage/ration receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_CONSERVATION, E_POLICY, E_UNIT, E_INPUT
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_CHECKPOINT, E_RANGE, E_OVERLAP, E_VERSION, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_GUARD, E_PROPOSAL_REQUIRED

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.
이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D04-population-labor-reconciliation(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/population-labor-reconciliation.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/population-labor-reconciliation.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
